Practice-squad additions included Will Levis among several new names as the team digests an overtime loss to Green Bay. Coach Aaron Glenn continues to stress defensive yardage strength while looking ahead to Detroit.

10c631125e29b635579fb12a76ab1bcf80c2743c.headline: Penguins list Ben Kindel day-to-day with lower-body injury after shot block
10c631125e29b635579fb12a76ab1bcf80c2743c.summary: Pittsburgh said Tuesday that 19-year-old forward Ben Kindel is day-to-day with a lower-body injury after leaving Monday’s preseason win over Buffalo late in the first period when he blocked a shot with his foot. Kindel had centered a line with Bryan Rust and Andrei Kuzmenko before exiting. With Blake Lizotte also banged up, the Penguins’ center depth is already a story as camp rolls toward the Sept. 30 opener.

e481ff19f4eb3139072ca507fcb8cc387e27bd67.headline: Connecticut Renaissance Faire heads into Faerie Ring Revels weekend (Sept 26–27)
e481ff19f4eb3139072ca507fcb8cc387e27bd67.summary: The Connecticut Renaissance Faire in Lebanon continues its 2026 season with Faerie Ring Revels on September 26–27, featuring fairy and flora costume contests after Shirefolk Weekend. The faire runs on select weekends through late October. For anyone mapping a New England autumn outing with jousts, crafts, and themed weekends, this is the near-term date to circle.

51bc4570441adae9e66db69d433188ca58f18ce9.headline: New England fall foliage 2026: healthier color after a wet reset, slower peak march
51bc4570441adae9e66db69d433188ca58f18ce9.summary: WBUR’s free foliage outlook says New England’s 2026 color season should look healthier than last year’s dull, early drop after a classic snowy winter and summer rain recharged soils. Peak still marches north-to-south — far northern New England late September, central mid-October, coastal Connecticut late October into early November — but a gradual cooldown may stretch the show. Early color seekers should head north over the next couple of weeks.

6975ad191d5193a5b736715f9800be6f38a46fd2.headline: Westport Volunteer EMS recruiting for EMT course — life-saving skills for Fairfield County
6975ad191d5193a5b736715f9800be6f38a46fd2.summary: Westport Volunteer EMS continues its long local tradition of training community EMTs, with coursework covering bandaging, childbirth, and multi-system trauma under veteran instructors. Officials say seats fill quickly with adults from across Fairfield County who want to volunteer. The squad’s mix of paid staff, volunteers, and Norwalk Hospital paramedic backup underpins 24/7 coverage for the town.

7b5dabe2899a0b12cb00d51c8ec369b244c6ae50.headline: Karen Woodall clarifies unauthorized article and distances work from PASG framing
7b5dabe2899a0b12cb00d51c8ec369b244c6ae50.summary: On September 11 expert Karen Woodall publicly clarified that an article bearing her name and photo appeared in Contemporary Family Quarterly without her submission or permission. She notes she left the Parental Alienation Study Group in 2019 and no longer uses classic parental-alienation diagnostic frameworks, focusing instead on children’s attachment adaptations and coerced alignment. Her book The Journey of the Alienated Child is slated for Routledge this autumn.

a6a1c769ad206ea8ac84b34fb98b2510edb4b290.headline: iPhone Duo countdown: 15 features to know before October pre-orders
a6a1c769ad206ea8ac84b34fb98b2510edb4b290.summary: Apple’s first foldable iPhone Duo is racing toward October 16 pre-orders and an October 23 launch after the September 9 “Surprise and Shine” event. MacRumors rounds up hinge design, dual displays, A20 Pro silicon, dual-battery behavior, IP68 sealing, and the $1,999 starting price. Separately, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12 with the new Health Sensing System began shipping September 18.

4e351a7cffe6a1e21731c0937be201caca32a36d.headline: 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A: retro tribute to the original Willys CJ-2A
4e351a7cffe6a1e21731c0937be201caca32a36d.summary: Jeep’s September reveal of the Wrangler JL-2A — part of the Twelve 4 Twelve special-edition run — tips its hat to the 1945 Willys CJ-2A with retro styling on a Rubicon foundation. Orders are expected to open in October for a limited run aimed at heritage buyers. Separately, Jeep and Harley-Davidson kept their European community partnership visible at Bike Week earlier this month.

e2a63fc3fdc76961a27aa83ac6bc7410bf80a3b1.headline: Penguins’ center depth already tested as Kindel and Lizotte deal with injuries
e2a63fc3fdc76961a27aa83ac6bc7410bf80a3b1.summary: Pittsburgh’s preseason opened with a 4–1 win over Buffalo and a 7–4 loss to Detroit, but the bigger story is early injury noise down the middle. TribLive reports Ben Kindel and Blake Lizotte issues already stressing center depth, with additional day-to-day tags on Brazeau and Koivunen. Fans tracking the Penguins’ runway into the regular season will want every update from camp medicals.

f0c3da000241fb7c903f09cc74344aa1cad96961.headline: Adirondacks travel pitch: peak foliage paired with family adventure
f0c3da000241fb7c903f09cc74344aa1cad96961.summary: As September tips into foliage season, the Adirondacks are getting fresh national travel ink for combining early color with family-friendly outdoor itineraries. Guides emphasize shoulder-season pacing — cooler hikes, lake towns, and fewer midsummer crowds than peak July. Elsewhere, fall destination marketing is pushing Smokies and Great Lakes alternatives alongside classic New England leaf-peeping.

a51e8bf028eb1a53147e91533c72e669aff60684.headline: Trumbull Farm Fair Sept. 26 at Chester Hill Farm — pony rides and barn open house
a51e8bf028eb1a53147e91533c72e669aff60684.summary: Chester Hill Farm in Trumbull will host a farm fair Saturday, Sept. 26, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. at 55 Old Dairy Road. The hunter/jumper facility plans pony rides, a barn open house, local vendors, and a tack tag sale on its 20-acre campus.

52090a36294737ee23549be657afb75965f5000c.headline: Marjorie Taylor Greene at TribFest: ‘MAGA is dead,’ calls movement a cult
52090a36294737ee23549be657afb75965f5000c.summary: Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene told the Texas Tribune Festival that “MAGA is dead,” labeling the broader Trump movement a “cult” while saying she still believes in America First. She cited broken campaign promises, the Iran war, and private Republican fear of Trump’s Truth Social posts after her public break with the president.

3276da8004cc960f98534927782755e204dd74fc.headline: Trump and Xi trade warm state-dinner toasts with little progress on Taiwan or AI
3276da8004cc960f98534927782755e204dd74fc.summary: At a lavish White House state dinner, Trump and Xi Jinping traded warm toasts about harmony and responsible major-power ties, but offered little public progress on Taiwan, trade, or AI rivalry. Tech CEOs including Elon Musk, Tim Cook, and Jensen Huang joined the meal as Xi heads into a Friday Archives tour before departing.

c4629a2e647dc9e04c45060f70dc62e58d0c35a3.headline: HSI and FBI arrest Senegalese LPR accused of voting in multiple N.J. elections
c4629a2e647dc9e04c45060f70dc62e58d0c35a3.summary: Homeland Security Investigations and the FBI arrested Sanata Coulibaly, a Senegalese lawful permanent resident, on charges of unlawful naturalization procurement and voting by an alien. DHS says she allegedly voted in the 2018, 2020, and 2024 New Jersey general elections and admitted voting in 2020 and 2024.

44e23e8d40c81af223a3261e33b468fde72f6f3e.headline: Two hurt as activists and ICE clash at Meriden courthouse
44e23e8d40c81af223a3261e33b468fde72f6f3e.summary: A confrontation at Meriden’s courthouse left one activist pepper-sprayed and another taken by ambulance after being pushed during an ICE arrest. Activists argued agents violated Connecticut’s Trust Act mask and courthouse limits; Judicial Branch officials said marshals received a warrant and are reviewing video.

409973b619b40df116d45470592644869c9eec30.headline: CT volunteer firefighter ranks shrink — state launches fire-protection audit
409973b619b40df116d45470592644869c9eec30.summary: Connecticut Public reports the state has lost nearly two-thirds of its volunteer firefighters since 2017, with over 60% of departments still volunteer-run. Officials cite two-income households, leadership, and training gaps as daytime staffing frays, while a new law will require local fire-protection plans starting in July 2027.

c9ba518b090ba768e2e99538f915666cfd3fc49f.headline: ‘MacBook Ultra’ rumored with OLED, touchscreen, Dynamic Island, thinner design
c9ba518b090ba768e2e99538f915666cfd3fc49f.summary: MacRumors rounds up reports that Apple’s next high-end laptop may debut as a MacBook Ultra above today’s M5 Pro/Max MacBook Pros, with OLED panels, native touch, a reinforced hinge, a thinner chassis, and an interactive Dynamic Island-style cutout. Timing is loosely pegged for late 2026 amid memory-chip constraints.

a64523c228d27e9d7896b04532440b88a619927f.headline: Insta360 Spatial Capture turns X5/X6 360 video into walkable 3D scenes — free Sept. 28
a64523c228d27e9d7896b04532440b88a619927f.summary: Insta360’s Spatial Capture update, due Sept. 28, converts up to two minutes of 360 video from the X6, X5, and X4 Air into explorable 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes in the cloud. Owners of last-gen cameras get the feature without buying new hardware; four scene generations a month are free.

09880ff7909a00f3b829f4289d7f60fb15e2b766.headline: Penguins prospects blanked 4–0 by Blue Jackets in preseason Game 3
09880ff7909a00f3b829f4289d7f60fb15e2b766.summary: Pittsburgh’s mostly young lineup was shut out 4–0 in Columbus as Sergei Murashov played the full game. Coach Dan Muse praised the work ethic against a veteran Blue Jackets group and called the matchup a useful evaluation ahead of the Sept. 29 regular-season opener.

2f9af1e54c2a776fe4eda71f9b75aca4412c54d4.headline: Starship aces Flight 14 wet dress; Monday orbital attempt still targeted
2f9af1e54c2a776fe4eda71f9b75aca4412c54d4.summary: SpaceX completed a wet dress rehearsal for Starship Flight 14, keeping a Monday Sept. 28 window that opens at 8:15 a.m. EDT. The planned first orbital attempt would send Ship around Earth six times, deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites, and splash down off Chile.

44af46eb335a6ef8534647da6614063b9cd55c89.headline: Tesla Android app leak shows Optimus ‘Gen 3’ robot asset filenames
44af46eb335a6ef8534647da6614063b9cd55c89.summary: A teardown of Tesla’s Android app found signed assets labeled robot_*_gen3.png, confirming an internal Gen 3 Optimus label. The sealed-joint renders look more finished than prior demos; Tesla has not commented on timing as Optimus factory work at Giga Texas continues.

f6da7cbf8c05634fa6e0ca606beb15e6ccf7cf02.headline: LEGO Icons SpongeBob Bikini Bottom: 1,794 pieces, $219.99, now on sale
f6da7cbf8c05634fa6e0ca606beb15e6ccf7cf02.summary: LEGO’s first adult SpongeBob set (11386) builds Bikini Bottom with SpongeBob’s pineapple, Squidward’s house, Patrick’s rock, and Jellyfish Fields across 1,794 pieces for $219.99. Minifigures plus brick-built Gary and DoodleBob ship with the set, on sale since Sept. 1 after a July unveil.

880310139bce655f2f33426072def08ebef98203.headline: National Public Lands Day Sept. 26: Forest Service and Army Corps fee waivers — not all parks
880310139bce655f2f33426072def08ebef98203.summary: Saturday’s National Public Lands Day waives many Forest Service day-use and Army Corps recreation fees, but it is not a nationwide National Park Service free-entry day. Planners should verify the land manager, concession rules, and whether volunteer events offer a future-entry coupon.

c37124f3360f996307694cd2aa8846822f33e6cf.headline: Jets enter Lions Week 3 No. 1 in total defense; Glenn calls Ford Field ‘a place we want to win’
c37124f3360f996307694cd2aa8846822f33e6cf.summary: Official Lions coverage of Jets Week 3 quotes Aaron Glenn on returning to Ford Field and highlights New York’s No. 1 total and rush defense after holding Titans and Packers under 200 yards. Jets players flag Jahmyr Gibbs as the top run-stopping challenge Sunday.
